The '''akonije trees''' were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]].<ref name="Bacta War">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref> Akonije trees grew through and on the roof of the main building of the [[Xucphra City]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> On the way to the [[Raid on the Dlarit estate]] as part of the [[Bacta War]], [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]] hunkered beside the trunk of an akonije tree.<ref name="Bacta War" />
